hero.title: Engineering better decisions through optimization and AI.

about.label: About
about.title: From mathematical models to production-ready decision systems.
about.text1: I am an Operations Research Engineer with a strong background in mathematical optimization, machine learning and software engineering.
about.text2: My work focuses on transforming complex industrial problems into reliable decision-support solutions, from mathematical modeling and algorithm design to software integration and production.
about.text3: I particularly enjoy working at the intersection of optimization, AI, energy systems and industrial software.
